datasets.title: Population living in low elevation coastal zones (0-10m and 0-20m above sea level)
datasets.description: Proportion of population in Pacific Island Countries and Territories (PICTs) living in Low Elevation Coastal Zones (LECZ) of 0-10 and 0-20 meters above sea level. LECZ were delineated using the bathub method overlaid on the Advanced Land Observing Satellite (ALOS) Global Digital Surface Model (AW3D30). Populations within the LECZs were estimated using the Pacific Community (SPC) Statistics for Development Division's 100m2 population grids. Find more Pacific data on PDH.stat . Access this dataset from the Pacific Data Hub. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/pdh-population-living-in-low-elevation-coastal-zones-0-10m-and-0-20m-above-sea-level]

lineage.description: Low elevation coastal zones (0-10m and 0-20m above sea level) were delineated using the bathtub method applied to the ALOS AW3D30 digital surface model. Population counts within these zones were estimated by overlaying SPC's 100m² population grids, producing a spatial inventory of populations at risk to coastal hazards.
